evidence_added.snippet:
def get_item_by_id(db: Connection, item_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT id, title, price FROM items WHERE id = ?", (item_id,))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    return dict(row) if row else None

items.why: Added parameterized SQLite SELECT query with positional parameter binding in app/db.py:18-35.
items.remaining_limitation: Queries are verified statically with parameterized bindings; transactions and connection pooling not yet configured.

def test_get_item_by_id(test_db):
    res = get_item_by_id(test_db, 1)
    assert res is not None
    assert res["title"] == "Test Widget"
    assert res["price"] == 19.99
